Position: Cabinet Maker
Type: Full-time
Employer: Final Touch Joinery Pty Ltd
Location: Kenthurst NSW 2156
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Final Touch Joinery Pty Ltd is a reputable North-West Sydney-based cabinetry specialist established in 2006 by Director Nathan Diab. With a strong commitment to quality craftsmanship and exceptional customer service, the company specialises in custom kitchen joinery, wardrobes, vanities, and architectural fit-outs for both residential and commercial clients, including high-end homes, unit developments, pubs, clubs, and insurance repair projects. Using premium materials and advanced CAD software, Final Touch Joinery delivers tailored solutions that bring clients’ visions to life with precision, durability, and elegant finishes. The business prides itself on a collaborative, detail-oriented workplace culture where innovation meets traditional joinery skills in a supportive environment focused on excellence and client satisfaction.
About the Position:
The Cabinet Maker plays a vital role in fabricating, assembling, and installing high-quality custom cabinetry, kitchens, wardrobes, and other joinery solutions for Final Touch Joinery’s diverse residential and commercial projects. Working from detailed drawings and client specifications, this position contributes directly to creating functional, beautiful spaces that meet the highest standards of finish and craftsmanship, helping the company maintain its reputation for premium, personalised results in the joinery industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Examining drawings, work orders, and sample parts to determine specifications.
Selecting and working with materials such as timber, veneers, particle board, laminates, and other engineered wood products.
Marking out, cutting, shaping, and assembling components using hand tools, power tools, and computer numerical control (CNC) machines where applicable.
Fabricating and installing kitchen, bathroom, and other cabinetry, wardrobes, counters, and fittings.
Fitting hinges, locks, catches, drawers, shelves, and other hardware with precision.
Ensuring all work meets quality standards, safety requirements, and client expectations.
Collaborating with the team on commercial and residential fit-outs, including repairs and custom solutions.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Minimum Certificate III in Cabinet Making and Installation, Joinery, or any relevant field or at least 2 years of relevant experience.
Minimum 2 years of experience as a cabinet maker or in a related field.
Strong technical skills in reading technical drawings, precise measurement, woodworking machinery operation, and use of hand/power tools.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.
Good interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and understand client requirements.
Physical fitness and ability to work safely in a workshop and on-site environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We are looking for a qualified electrician to join our team in Brisbane.

We're after a good tradesman. Someone who turns up on time, works hard, communicates well, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something properly from the ground up.

We're a new electrical contracting business (started January 2026), doing commercial and industrial work with some residential on the side. We're deliberately not chasing the same job over and over — we partner with good clients across a variety of work and aim to service them end to end. We're a relationship-first contractor, and because we're small, you'll work directly with the owner, not through layers of management.

If you want to be part of something from the start — not just join a business, but help shape one — this is that opportunity.

What We Offer
Tool-for-trade vehicle (likely brand new)
38-hour week with half-day Fridays
Competitive Hourly Rate
Overtime and allowances available
Quality tools and equipment
Direct access to the owner — no chaos, no red tape
Real variety of work through long-term client relationships, not the same job on repeat
The chance to help shape a growing company and grow with it

The Role
You'll be working across a genuine variety of commercial and industrial projects (with some residential), carrying out electrical installation, fit-off, fault finding, testing, maintenance, and general project work. Because we service clients end to end, you'll get exposure to different job types rather than doing the same thing on repeat. As we grow, there's real opportunity to take on more responsibility early — leading jobs, mentoring apprentices, and helping set up how we do things.

What We're Looking For
Current QLD Electrical Licence
Current CPR / LVR
Manual driver's licence
Solid trade experience — early career or experienced both welcome
Strong workmanship and attention to detail
Good attitude and reliable work ethic
Comfortable across a variety of work, not just one type of job
Ability to work well independently and communicate professionally with clients
Pride in presentation, cleanliness, and quality
Someone looking for a long-term role and keen to grow with a company from the start

We don't want big talkers or shortcuts — just a solid electrician who does the job properly and wants to grow with a company that's going somewhere.

About Us
We are a Brisbane-based electrical contracting business specialising in commercial and industrial work. We work across true variety, including:
Water/wastewater utilities — instrumentation, maintenance and construction on pump stations, treatment plants and more
Power station shutdown projects
High-end residential developments
Commercial construction, including fitouts
Switchboard maintenance and breakdowns
Data and air conditioning systems

Our aim is to be a solid, well-rounded electrical contractor with the skilled people to back it up. We're relationship-first — we'd rather do great work for a smaller number of good clients across a genuine variety of jobs than churn through the same repetitive work. As a new business, we're building our team, systems, and reputation from the ground up, with a focus on doing things properly from day one.

The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, and experienced in working with complex network and communication technologies.

Install, configure and commission telecommunications equipment including routers, switches, cabling and transmission systems
Integrate telecommunications networks with computer systems, hardware, software and operating environments
Diagnose and resolve faults in network infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and service disruption
Monitor network performance and conduct routine maintenance to optimise system reliability and efficiency
Maintain accurate records of equipment, configurations, inventory and service activities
Prepare and update technical documentation, including procedures, policies and compliance standards
Provide technical support and guidance to clients, stakeholders and internal teams
Conduct site inspections, testing and troubleshooting of telecommunications systems in field environments
Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations and organisational quality requirements
Coordinate with vendors, service providers and project teams to support installations and upgrades
Support the deployment of new technologies, upgrades and network expansions
Respond to service requests and incidents within agreed service level timeframes

Experience with telecommunications equipment, cabling standards and transmission technologies
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in field-based environments

Excellent problem-solving, analytical and organisational skills
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work independently and manage multiple service tasks effectively
Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to various job sites
Preferred Qualifications
Industry certifications such as Cisco (CCNA/CCNP), CompTIA Network+ or equivalent
Experience with fibre optics, wireless networks or mobile telecommunications systems
Knowledge of network monitoring tools and diagnostic software
Experience working in large-scale infrastructure or enterprise environments
Understanding of Australian telecommunications standards and compliance requirements
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work on diverse and large-scale telecommunications projects

Career progression within a growing organisation
Competitive salary package with additional benefits

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Telecommunications Network Planner to join our team and play a key role in the planning, design, and ongoing development of customer access telecommunications network infrastructure. The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. This role suits an experienced professional with a solid background in telecommunications network planning, optimisation, and operational support who is looking to make a meaningful contribution within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Plan, develop, and maintain customer access telecommunications network infrastructure to support organisational growth and service delivery objectives
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and service providers to manage contractual obligations, monitor performance delivery, and ensure agreed service levels are met
- Design and optimise telecommunications networks, ensuring solutions are cost-effective, scalable, and aligned with business and technical requirements
- Provide ongoing operational support by troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving network performance malfunctions, defects, and faults in a timely manner
- Conduct detailed network capacity planning and demand forecasting to anticipate future infrastructure requirements and prevent service degradation
- Analyse network data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement targeted optimisation strategies
- Prepare and maintain accurate technical documentation, including network plans, design specifications, and project reports
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and project management to deliver network projects on time and within budget
- Assess and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to support continuous improvement across the network planning function
- Ensure all planning activities comply with relevant industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks
- Support field teams and technical staff by providing clear guidance and planning documentation during network rollout and upgrade activities
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in telecommunications network planning, design, or a closely related technical role
- Strong working knowledge of customer access network technologies, including fibre, copper, HFC, and wireless infrastructure
- Proficiency in network planning and design tools, GIS platforms, and relevant industry software
- Solid understanding of network protocols, architecture principles, and performance management practices
- Proven ability to analyse complex technical data, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions
- Experience managing and coordinating external vendors and suppliers, including oversight of contractual performance
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes within defined timeframes
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualifications or industry certifications in telecommunications, network engineering, or project management (e.g. CCNP, PMP, or equivalent)
- Experience working within NBN, fibre-to-the-premises (FTTP), or large-scale national telecommunications rollout programmes

For over 45+ years, Walz have been providing specialist maintenance and construction solutions for the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. We take a multi-disciplinary approach to deliver safe, reliable, cost-effective solutions.

The heart of our service delivery is our team of highly skilled, long-term employees who possess a breadth and depth of experience that enables us to support a diverse range of projects. We have offices in Brisbane, Gladstone, and Mackay.

We are seeking qualified Painters to join our team of dedicated professionals. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

As a Painter you are responsible for the preparation, abrasive blasting, and application of protective coating systems to steel and other substrates in accordance with client specifications, industry standards, and company Safety and quality requirements. The role operates across construction, mining, marine, and oil & gas projects, with a strong focus on safety, quality, environmental compliance, and productivity.

Key Performance Indicators & Accountabilities – Roles and Responsibilities

Surface Preparation
Mobilise and demobilise blasting hoppers, spray pumps, encapsulation systems, and associated equipment.
Prepare surfaces through abrasive blasting ranging from whip blasting to Class SA 3 on ferrous and non-ferrous substrates.
Operate blasting equipment using garnet, steel grit, and other approved abrasive media.
Inspect prepared surfaces to ensure compliance with coating specifications and cleanliness standards.

Protective Coating Application
Mix and apply protective coating systems in accordance with manufacturer's recommendations and project specifications.
Apply coatings using airless spray equipment, brushes, and rollers.
Apply striped coats to welds, edges, bolts, and difficult-to-coat areas.
Apply multi-coat systems while achieving specified Dry Film Thickness (DFT) requirements.
Apply a range of coating systems including: Inorganic zinc coatings, Epoxy zinc primers, High-build epoxy coatings, Antifouling coatings, Acrylic & polyurethane finishes.
Conduct touch-up and remediation work following quality inspections to achieve specification compliance.

Quality Assurance
Work to industrial coating specifications, inspection test plans (ITPs), and client quality requirements.
Measure and record Wet Film Thickness (WFT) and Dry Film Thickness (DFT) where required.
Complete remedial work identified during quality inspections.
Maintain accurate production and quality records Safety Management.
Comply with all workplace health and safety legislation, company policies, and client requirements.
Identify hazards, assess risks, and implement appropriate controls.
Participate in incident reporting and investigations.
Promote a positive safety culture and lead by example

General Duties
Assist with general workshop and site duties as required.
Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox talks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support supervisors and project teams to achieve production schedules and project milestones.

Environmental Management
Comply with environmental management plans and legislative requirements.
Minimise waste and prevent environmental contamination.
Correctly manage hazardous substances and waste disposal.
Ensure blasting containment and environmental protection controls are maintained

Audits and Inspections
Participate in internal and external quality and safety audits.
Cooperate with coating inspectors and quality personnel.
Rectify identified defects promptly.
Maintain accurate documentation and inspection records.

Commercial
Complete work efficiently to meet project budgets and schedules.
Minimise rework through quality workmanship.
Care for company equipment and materials to reduce waste.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity and customer satisfaction

Skills and Knowledge
Demonstrated experience working to industrial coating specifications.
Experience in construction, mining, oil & gas, or heavy industrial sectors.
Current White Card.
Current Australian Driver Licence.
Strong understanding of safe work practices.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Reliable, proactive, and safety focused.

Qualifications
Certificate III in Surface Preparation and Coating Application.
AMPP (formerly NACE) Coating Inspection qualification.
Asbestos Class A and/or Class B Licence.
Working at Heights certification.
Confined Space Entry certification.
Elevated Work Platform (EWP) and Forklift licences

Technical Competency
Interpret coating specifications, product data sheets, and work instructions.
Operate blasting and spray-painting equipment safely and efficiently.
Achieve specified coating thickness and quality.
Maintain equipment in a serviceable condition

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: 38 hours $44.63/hr + Super. Guaranteed overtime paid in accordance with the applicable legislative instrument in place.
